findings.evidence: The secondary action #viewdetails-btn has explicit styling (padding: 12px 20px; font-size: 16px) while the primary submit button #submit-btn at line 74 has no explicit styling, reversing the prominence hierarchy.
findings.fix: Remove explicit styling from #viewdetails-btn or apply more prominent styling to #submit-btn to make the primary action visibly the most prominent. Rearrange the buttons so the primary submit button appears first or last with greater emphasis.
findings.violation: Secondary action is more prominently styled than the primary action, making it unclear which button is the main action.
